newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end slightly higher, land plan helps.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end slightly higher, land plan helps.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended slightly higher on Wednesday, continuing to benefit from government plans to breathe life into the property market. brokers said. They said selling to make up for shortfalls ahead of the end-March book closing also added to the downward pressure.
The Nikkei average finished at 18,493.71, up 48.51 points or 0.26 percent. Its June futures were up 30 points or 18,430.
"The indices rose, helped by continued appreciation of the government's plans to improve land liquidity," said Akihiro Naemura, general manager at Okasan Securities.
